newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3933/3.3943 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3933/3.3943 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3930 to 3.3960 pounds bid and 3.3915 and 3.3965 pounds offered in the interbank market on Thursday.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3933 bid and 3.3943 offered compared to 3.3926 bid and 3.3941 offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.389836 buy and 3.396076 sell.
